runs.emptyBody: Once you export an agent to CI, every automated review shows up here.
runs.title: CI Runs
runs.subtitle: Agent reviews executed inside CI · not local runs
runs.refreshFailed: Couldn't refresh from GitHub — showing the last known runs.

exportWizard.title: Export to CI
exportWizard.subtitle: Run {agentName} automatically on pull requests
exportWizard.repoHint: owner/name — the repo to add the workflow to
exportWizard.repoInvalid: Enter the target repository as owner/name, e.g. acme/payments-api.
exportWizard.workflowInvalidYaml: This workflow isn't valid YAML — fix the syntax before installing.
exportWizard.triggersRequired: Select at least one pull request event to trigger on.
exportWizard.blockMergeDesc: No GitHub App is required to block merges: turn on Fail CI on so the run exits non-zero on a violation, then add this workflow as a required status check in the repository's GitHub branch protection settings.
exportWizard.blockMergeNote: Fail CI on decides whether the run exits non-zero; the repository's branch protection is what actually stops the merge.
exportWizard.secretNote: Add {key} to the repo's Actions secrets before the workflow runs.
exportWizard.secretNoteAuto: Add {key} — your LLM API key (e.g. OPENROUTER_API_KEY) — to the repository's Actions secrets before the workflow runs. GITHUB_TOKEN is supplied automatically by GitHub Actions and needs no setup.

method.downloadHint: Downloads the generated files as a .zip — you add them to the repository yourself; nothing is marked installed until you confirm it below.

exportWizard.downloadConfirm: I've added these files to the repository
exportWizard.installCardTitle: Open a PR with these files
exportWizard.installCardBody: DevDigest opens a PR in {repo} titled “Add DevDigest CI review” with the {count} generated files.

ciTab.heading: Continuous Integration
ciTab.subtitle: Run this agent automatically on pull requests in a target repo.
ciTab.empty: Not deployed to CI yet. Use “Publish to CI” to open a PR that adds the workflow + agent config.
ciTab.emptyBody: Exporting adds a GitHub Actions workflow that runs this agent automatically on pull requests in a target repository.
ciTab.activeIn: Active in {count, plural, one {# repo} other {# repos}}

failOn.label: Fail CI on
failOn.hint: Shared with the Config tab's Fail CI on setting — changing it here updates the same value.

options.never: Never — CI never fails, regardless of findings
options.critical: Critical only — fails when a critical finding is reported
options.warning: Warning or higher — fails on a critical or warning finding
options.any: Any finding — fails on any finding, including suggestions

ciTab.branchProtectionNote: Failing CI does not block a merge by itself. Add this workflow as a required status check in the repository's branch protection settings to enforce it.
